title: The army of God numbered and ordered
english: The first reading of Numbers taught that God’s army, which [[went out from Egypt and marched through the desert >> Bible:Numbers 1:1-3]], was “visited” — numbered through Moses and Aaron. The form is prescribed: God’s people leaving this world’s Egypt for the land of promise — toward the place of virtues or the glory of the kingdom — advance by ranks and grades of merit.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC (Numbers).
After Leviticus SERIES CLOSEOUT 63fcac0c; Hexateuch continuation.

title: Each according to his signs
english: [[Each man according to his order and according to his signs shall pitch camp >> Bible:Numbers 2:2]]. “Signs” are the marks that name each person — and each soul: one mild, another stormy. Let each walk by his signs; by zeal we can move from lesser signs to greater. In the resurrection [[star differs from star in glory >> Bible:1 Corinthians 15:41]].

title: Nothing disordered — Homilia I CLOSEOUT
english: Let us walk and [[do all things in order >> Bible:1 Corinthians 14:40]]. If nothing disordered, restless, or shameful is found in us, then we shall [[shine like the sun in the kingdom >> Bible:Matthew 13:43]]. To him be glory forever. Homilia I CLOSEOUT. Amen.
